name_en: Report of the Senior Citizen Condition Survey 2013
data_description_zh: 資料為102 年老人狀況調查。
notes_zh:
1. 老人狀況調查於 75 年由行政院主計總處（原行政院主計處）於人力資源調查中
附帶辦理「青少年及老人狀況調查」；78 年起則改由行政院主計總處與內政部合
作辦理「老人狀況調查」，並隔年舉辦一次；84 年起移由內政部辦理，並分別於
85、89、91、94 及 98 年辦理 5 次，其間 96 年 1 月老人福利法修正，建立定
期辦理規制，102 年配合政府組織再造，本調查由內政部辦理前階段訪問作業，
衛福部完成後續整理及分析工作。
2. 本調查項目包括：蒐集年滿 55 歲以上民眾之居住狀況、就業狀況、經纃狀況、
自我照顧能力、對福利措施了解情形及對老年生活的期望與擔心問題等老人生活
福祉相關資訊，以作為研訂老人福利政策，以及加強老人服務與照顧措施之參據。
3. 調查實施計畫、抽樣設計、調查表，可參閱衛生福利部統計處網頁址：
https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-5095-113.html)。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分證
字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等欄位
均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通過
之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。

data_description_en: The data are from the 2013 (ROC year 102) Elderly Status Survey.
notes_en:
1. The Survey of the Elderly's Status was conducted in ROC year 75 (1986) by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, Executive Yuan (formerly the Executive Yuan Bureau of Accounting and Statistics) as an add-on to the manpower survey,
namely the "Survey of the Status of Youth and the Elderly"; from ROC year 78 (1989) it was jointly conducted by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, Executive Yuan and the Ministry of the Interior
as the "Survey of the Elderly's Status", held every other year; from ROC year 84 (1995) it was transferred to the Ministry of the Interior, which conducted it 5 times, in
ROC years 85 (1996), 89 (2000), 91 (2002), 94 (2005) and 98 (2009); in January of ROC year 96 (2007) the Senior Citizens Welfare Act was amended, establishing
a regular schedule; in ROC year 102 (2013), in line with the government's organizational restructuring, the Ministry of the Interior conducted the earlier-stage interviews of this survey,
and the Ministry of Health and Welfare completed the subsequent compilation and analysis.
2. The survey items include: collecting information on the living status, employment status, economic status,
self-care ability, awareness of welfare measures, and expectations and worries about later life of people aged 55 and over, and other information on the
living welfare of older adults, as a reference for formulating elderly welfare policies and strengthening elderly services and care measures.
3. For the survey implementation plan, sampling design and questionnaires, see the webpage of the Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare:
https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-5095-113.html).
※This Center's database has been de-identified: directly identifiable fields such as name and address have been deleted, and fields such as national ID
number, healthcare facility code, insured unit code, unified business number, date of birth, date of medical visit and date of admission
have all been masked. The data may only be used in the independent work area set up by this Ministry, and only statistical results that have passed review may be taken out,
to ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify specific individuals.
